# stb_image_write -- PNG writing (vendored)

`stb_image_write.h` from [nothings/stb](https://github.com/nothings/stb) at commit
`1ee679ca2ef753a528db5ba6801e1067b40481b8` (v1.16), unchanged. Its licence --
